description: Persist a validated Graph of Thoughts path to the long-term @mcp:memory Knowledge Graph server.

nodeId.description: The leaf node ID of the path to commit. If omitted, the highest-scoring converged path is used.

sessionId.description: Session ID for isolated reasoning paths.

dryRun.description: Preview the entities and relations that would be created without committing them.

deduplicate.description: Enable semantic identity check to prevent duplicate nodes in memory.
